english.title: Go onto / into any part of a restricted area of a ship without permission
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, went onto or into part of a restricted area of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY AREA AND SHIP..), other than with the permission of the master or the ship security officer or a person acting on their behalf and in accordance with conditions subject to which that permission was for the time being granted
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 10(1)(a) and (3) of the Ship and Port Facility (Security) Regulations 2004.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 10(3A) of the Ship and Port Facility (Security) Regulations 2004 provides that a person who contravenes regulation 10(1)(a) is not guilty of an offence unless it is proved that, at the material time, notices stating that the area concerned was a restricted area were posted so as to be readily seen and read by persons entering the area.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, went onto or into part of a restricted area of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY AREA AND SHIP..), other than with the permission of the master or the ship security officer or a person acting on their behalf and in accordance with conditions subject to which that permission was for the time being granted.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
